text.content: Downtown is the domain of the city's Elders, watched closely enough that the Anarchs avoid waging open war there. It hosts the Milwaukee Athletic Club, a favorite Kindred hunting ground where young, physically fit mortals make for low-risk, high-yield vessels, and the Performing Arts Center on the riverbank, where the Council sometimes holds diplomatic sessions during performances — sessions the Anarchs delight in disrupting with mocking performances of their own late at night.

The Barrens cover everything in Milwaukee outside of Downtown and the Outlands, and constitute Anarch territory — the site of most gang battles, since Downtown is too closely watched by the Elders. The Barrens hold ample hunting grounds tucked between tenements and nightclubs, and while safer than the Outlands, the Lupine occasionally slip in to ambush lone Cainites. Parovich keeps his haven, a condemned house perpetually saved from demolition through bureaucratic string-pulling, here.

Beyond the Barrens lies the Outlands, the buffer zone between Milwaukee proper and Lupine territory, patrolled constantly by Mark Decker's Anubi. Timmerman Airport, on the city's edge near the Outlands, sees little traffic and is consequently favored by Kindred (Anarch and occasional Elder alike) wanting a discreet, unwatched arrival or departure. Good Hope Road marks the informal northern boundary of Kindred-controlled territory, beyond which lies uncontested Lupine ground; it is Decker's most common patrol route and the traditional place to seek him out. Hrothulf keeps a suburban home deep in the Outlands that the Lupine have, notably, learned to avoid.

pages.name: The Blood Brothers and the Union

text.content: Milwaukee's Anarchs are divided between two dominant, warring gangs. The @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.antitribu.JournalEntry.hs33xrNXWT2UXXS4]{Blood Brothers}, led by the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.ZFYurbvAHfaRguYI]{Brujah} elder Akawa, has spent the last decade gaining ground against its rival, the East Side Anarchs Union (commonly "the Union"), led by the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.SNuXttNqxzJ6uPXv]{Caitiff} Turk. The gangs battle constantly, more often for the thrill of fighting than any strategic goal, in rumbles that would provoke a Blood Hunt in most other @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.fc464242d84d4e34]{Camarilla} cities but are simply tolerated as background noise in Milwaukee's chaos.

vtmlarp.source: Milwaukee by Night, Chapter Two: Geography
